notes:
- Intro call 2025-01-15 (Maya + Diego): VerdeBridge is building a trading desk assistant + reranking layer for signal surfacing. Primary constraint: sub-150ms tail latency for short prompts and strict data residency.
- Use cases: real-time trade assistant (short prompts 10-80 tokens), research summarization (200-600 tokens), reranking of candidate signals (lists up to 100 items).
- POC ask: Redwood Dedicated evaluation focused on throughput guarantees, latency SLOs, and reserved GPU planning. Customer requested cost/latency tradeoff analysis and SLA language.
- Performance targets captured on call: target p50 <= 45ms for short prompts, p95 <= 150ms for representative live traffic; sustained throughput target 250-350 QPS across reranking and chat mix; burst tolerance to 2x baseline.
- Proposed POC design:
  * Load test: scripted ramp 0->100% in 30m, hold at 100% for 2h, then step down. Multiple concurrency profiles (concurrency 16, 64, 128).
  * Soak test: 7-day run at 60-70% sustained load to check memory/throughput drift and KV cache behavior.
  * Stress bursts: repeated 5m bursts at 200% to validate fallback and dedicated burst capacity.
  * Representative prompts: short trade confirmations (6-30 tokens), multi-paragraph research Qs (150-400 tokens), rerank batches (lists of 20-100 items). Corpus stored in Drive link above.
  * Metrics: p50/p90/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory usage, KV-cache hit rate, kernel utilization, cost per 1M tokens.
- Model choices discussed: prefer open model family (Llama-like 13B quantized Q4f16) for reproducibility; also test a 70B variant for comparison. Ask Redwood for compiled kernel/quantization suggestions (ticket INF-4821).
- Infrastructure ask: estimate reserved GPUs: initial proposal 8 x A100-equivalent for baseline; have engineering to validate with sizing workbook. Need guidance on autoscale and burst configuration for Dedicated.
- Security & compliance: must satisfy SOC2 + SSO/SAML and ability to route logs to customer SIEM; legal requested 99.95% uptime, P1 response SLA 1 hour, monthly audit export — Redwood to provide draft SLA (linked).
